title: How Cooking One Real Meal a Week Makes a Godly Man Useful at Home
caption:
Useful isn't a feeling. It's a meal on the table on a schedule. One real dinner a week, cooked for someone else, finished all the way to the dishes. Jesus fed men breakfast on a beach after they failed Him. You can handle a pot of chili.

Pick the night. Start this week.

#faith #godlyman #service #discipline #christianmen
